reason: I'd maybe tap the free 14-day trial since there's no auto-billing, but paying every month for sleep sounds when YouTube with a sleep timer already works for me isn't happening. If I'm honest, I'd probably forget to keep the phone by the bed properly half the nights anyway.
objection: YouTube sleep music is free, why pay? The thing that sounds useful is the sound coming back when I wake at 3am, but I doubt phone-movement detection really knows I'm awake versus just rolling over.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison actually showed me falling back asleep clearly faster after waking, like 15+ minutes saved, I might pay the yearly plan.
